# Durable provider handoff: actual ChatView Before and After

This isolated diagnostic runs the same two complete new canonical handoff-admission cases on the cleaned current-main source and the repaired #1145 source. Before is 1a9d70983750bc771e850d72a858c541bac52885 (tree 6479afa46f65f176445f51a8fe9a859f67c4ab17). After is 2a53c3c7c20e6aec90f6eaf3067d292955d2686e (tree 4505c81b9128f56a758708c0581106490b3a5859), including the independently found workspace-admission and footer-state repairs. Both are declared in overlay.json. The diagnostic branch does not alter production files.

The common test file comes byte-for-byte from the repaired source. Removing only the two new cases reconstructs the original main test file exactly. The observer adds only named capture calls and a read-only helper; removing those additions reconstructs the common canonical fixture exactly. All original assertions, fixture replies and cleanup remain.

The full production router, ChatView, composer, CSS and theme run in Chromium. The existing fixture supplies controlled orchestration snapshots and provider readiness; no authenticated provider, actual CLI startup, native desktop session or native OS behavior is claimed. The draft and transcript contain synthetic review text.

Each case captures a pending request at desktop 960×1100 and narrow 480×640 before asserting the new admission UI. A matching completed or failed outcome then resumes editing, and passing cases capture both layouts again. The helper waits for real fonts and finite animations, without seeking animations or substituting geometry, DOM, CSS or components. It restores the original viewport after each capture pair.

Before is expected to retain two actual failed assertions because current main does not hydrate the durable pending gate. These remain failed job steps and failed verifier results; they are never converted into passing checks. A valid counterexample should retain four pending screenshots. After must pass both original cases and retain eight pending/settled screenshots. The rest of the canonical test file is explicitly filtered by this diagnostic and is not reported as passing; ordinary PR CI remains separate.

The original command and tee exit codes, report snapshot, stdout, production/driver source hashes, exact overlay/reversal receipts, PNGs and context video are retained. Live JSON, logs and exits are written to private runner temporary paths; live browser media uses a separate owned workspace directory. Only bounded stable regular-file snapshots enter the uploaded evidence tree before parsing and hashing. The unchanged, independently reviewed snapshot helper checks file/path identity and size before allocation, refuses links and changing/truncated/oversized sources, and bounds both directory inventory and total media bytes. The actual browser-step outcome is recorded even when a timeout prevents a normal exit receipt. Missing/partial reports, source drift, unexpected cases, missing images or nonzero exits remain failures. Later live writes cannot change the retained copies. GitHub step/job timeouts and a stable cutoff do not prove descendant cleanup or completion of every writer's lifetime.

The first unreferenced driver was repaired during independent review because its media and logs still shared upload destinations with live writers. Its source and all canonical test assertions are unchanged; the correction isolates and freezes evidence writers. Local observer typechecking also found and corrected an overbroad mount parameter type, retaining the original two diagnostics. Neither failed attempt reached browser execution.

The first actual browser outcomes are retained below. No passing execution of the final repaired source is claimed at the time this follow-up driver is proposed. The eventual evidence report must retain all failed attempts and label exact capture source identities separately from any later feature changes.

The first published source run (38191448841, browser job114624923825) retained 133 passes and two failures: both new cases looked up the old Send message label. The initial source child changed only that locator to Connecting, retaining its disabled assertion and settled Send message enabled assertion. That correction was insufficient: its review had read the later submit-label expression but missed the earlier connecting-to-Stop branch. The next source run (38192727438, browser job114628795172) retained both failures because Connecting was also absent. The observer selects the actual form submit control and records its real accessible label in both sources. All failed raw logs remain separate from the proposed source repair.

## First actual run and focused footer repair

Run `38193107887` retained two real failures per source. Before main+format `1a9d709` captured the pending states and then failed the original missing handoff-status assertion. After `53248e7` failed the observer's one-submit guard: the existing footer routes `connecting` to an enabled **Stop generation** control before reaching its later `Connecting` submit label. Thus the previous locator-only feature child did not repair the production branch. Its raw log, report and recording remain evidence of that failed attempt. Sampled frames of that After recording are blank and cannot establish interaction behavior.

The final source repair uses `handoffPending` separately from ordinary connection startup. The common full ChatView cases remain byte-for-byte unchanged. The After source is now `2a53c3c7c20e6aec90f6eaf3067d292955d2686e` / tree `4505c81b9128f56a758708c0581106490b3a5859`. Actual filtered Vitest 4 cases use `skipped`; the observer recognizes `pending` or `skipped` only for the 220 nonselected cases and still requires exactly two executed cases.

A separate pair runs the exact complete six-case canonical footer fixture on Before `53248e7` and After `2a53c3c7`. All three existing Stop/voice cases must pass on both. The three new ready/connecting/running cases require one disabled submit, no Stop control, a disabled microphone, then the enabled Send and microphone after a real React rerender to settled state. Before ignores the new input and must visibly fail those three assertions; those browser steps and jobs remain failures. No test-name filtering is used for this pair. Its live logs, reports, exits and original failure screenshots are frozen through the same bounded stable snapshot helper before parsing or hashing. This control does not prove provider or native desktop behavior.
